categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and changes AddrMan address selection in src/addrman.cpp and src/net.cpp for GETADDR responses and RPC address retrieval.
categories.rationale: Prevents GETADDR and getnodeaddresses underfill when nodes have large numbers of banned or discouraged peers. While mzumsande notes that returning full address sets prevents peers from inferring banlist size, the issue only manifests under heavy ban or discouragement states and is reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes to src/test/addrman_tests.cpp and src/test/fuzz/addrman.cpp merely update tests to match the AddrMan API changes rather than modifying shared test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: The test additions specifically test AddrMan selection behavior and do not change general test harness infrastructure.
